items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: So, at the casino, and Wade Whaley, Black Pete, myself, and Piron, and four of us.

ctx.x: He might be. He could well be.

Yeah, now we supplied in the district together with Piron. So, at the casino, and Wade Whaley, Black Pete, myself, and Piron, and four of us. Four, that's all. You never did. Piron ever used no until after the district went down. Did you ever know Black Pete's real name? That's all I ever know, little Black Pete. That's all I ever know. That's all I ever know. That's all this way he taught, little Black Pete. You remember him. No, I never knew him, but everybody.
